name: relay
description: The system of work: observe (ledger), delegate (typed agents by tier), front (the owner-facing session), core (bindings, guard, flow stage), and the task flows sdd (OpenSpec) and issues, plus product (look review).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: kit helper (bindings, task briefs, spec checks), main-checkout guard, project additions injected into shared roles, the flow stage hook.

plugins.name: observe
plugins.description: The ledger: every session, prompt, agent, tool call and compaction as one JSON line, read by `relay report`, `relay status`, `relay improve`.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Typed agents by tier (scout, runner, worker, fixer, thinker, critic) with model and effort from the active profile; the routing guard; the delegate skill (brief files, who does what).

plugins.name: front
plugins.description: The front desk: context budget and handover hooks, the front skill (one reply per request, plain words, numbered choices).

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: OpenSpec flow: stage skills plan, spec-review, parallel-apply, apply-review, archive, and their agents.

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Issue flow: pick, implement, review, merge, with the tracker and hosting commands bound in kit.toml.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Look review of person-facing work: the ui-reviewer agent and its measuring script.
